Votes that approved its contracts

How each member voted, from the minutes
  • PassedApproved wastewater plant engineering agreement with Mott Macdonald · $3.49M Jun 25, 2024 · Lynn Haven City Commission · 5-0 · MinutesJesse Nelson yes · Sam Peebles yes · Pat Perno yes · Jamie Warrick yes · Judy Vandergrift yesApproves: Advanced Wastewater Treatment Facility engineering services (plus allowance up to $245,000) ($3.49M, Jun 21, 2024). Matched by vendor name, agenda item, amount.

Votes are linked to a contract when the same government voted within 45 days and the minutes agree with the agenda record in at least two ways (company name, bid number, project words or amount). Many contracts are approved on a consent agenda with routine items in one vote. A campaign gift near a vote, or from a company that holds a contract, is a fact in two public records. It does not show why anyone voted the way they did, or how a contract was awarded.

Every connection (45)

A campaign gift and a vote, contract or payment appearing together are facts in two public records. They do not show why anyone voted the way they did or how a contract was awarded. Individual campaign donors are named only when they run a registered business; others are counted in totals. This profile in the API.

About this page

  • Awards are agenda amounts, not money paid. Register and tourism-agency payments come from the lists each source publishes, which cover only part of each year.
  • CRA records that the ledger leaves out of its totals (parts of a larger project, or not CRA money) are listed but not added up.
  • Vendor id mott-macdonald in the downloads (column vendor_id).
